workflow.description: Absolute path to the workflow file.

outputs.description: URLs or local paths to produced artifacts.

outputs_by_node.description: --wait only (both targets): the same artifact URLs grouped by the node id that produced them.

outputs_by_item.description: --wait only (both targets): artifact URLs grouped by blueprint foreach item (via the compose item_map). Empty object when no item_map exists.

warnings.description: Cloud --wait only: non-fatal diagnostics about the run (e.g. partial_execution when the cloud pruned an output branch). Empty when none.

cached_node_ids.description: Local --wait only: node ids the server reported as cached. Derived from the per-node event stream, which --where cloud does not have.

executed_node_ids.description: Local --wait only: node ids the executor ran. Derived from the per-node event stream, which --where cloud does not have.

state_file.description: Path of the job state file (poll with `comfy jobs status`).

watcher_spawned.description: Async (no --wait) only, both targets: whether the detached state-file watcher started. Poll `comfy jobs status` yourself when false.
